role: Extension of RecoveryScoreCalculatorTests with vitals override/sub-score cases, calculateWithBreakdown tier and weight composition (HRV/Sleep/Vitals 60/25/15, Tier-2 70/30 and 85/15 dampening, comeback 80/20/0), training-context independence, comeback-mode window, toTenScale, ScoringConfiguration and personal-baseline wrist temperature.
types: extension RecoveryScoreCalculatorTests — composite, vitals and configuration tests

units.does: Asserts applyVitalsOverrides(score: 75, vitals: nil) returns 75.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass
